releaseNotes: Pause works. Android was dropping every play/pause command the player was sent - they were delivered to the wrong place in the page and silently vanished
Volume and the fine drift correction were dropped the same way and now work too
A track running out while the Session is paused no longer switches the room back on
Track search asks YouTube for music specifically and prefers the label's own audio uploads, which carry far fewer adverts

notes: Pause works. Android was dropping every play/pause command the player was sent - they were delivered to the wrong place in the page and silently vanished
Volume and the fine drift correction were dropped the same way and now work too
A track running out while the Session is paused no longer switches the room back on
Track search asks YouTube for music specifically and prefers the label's own audio uploads, which carry far fewer adverts
Pause now holds. The app checks every couple of seconds that a paused track has really stopped, and re-issues the pause if the player ignored it
A track running out while the Session is paused no longer switches the room back on
Track search asks YouTube for music specifically and prefers the label's own audio uploads, which carry far fewer adverts
Pause actually stops the music. The player could swallow a pause and nothing ever checked - the app now watches what the player is really doing and corrects it
A track running out while the Session is paused no longer switches the room back on
Track search asks YouTube for music specifically and prefers the label's own audio uploads, which carry far fewer adverts
The navigation bar and the return bar are frosted now instead of see-through - the feed no longer reads straight through them
The hard grey rectangle under both bars is gone; the shadow follows their rounded edge
Android never actually blurred, so the glass is built out of opacity, which the phone really draws
Fixes the crash when you minimise a Session - the return bar and the navigation bar were both asking Android to blur the same thing, which killed the app a few seconds later
On Android the return bar is a solid capsule instead of glass. That is what stops the crash
Back no longer leaves a Session - it minimises to a bar above the navigation, and only Leave ends it
The Session says which service your audio is coming from, and whether minimising will keep it playing
Changing the lobby mode lives in one place now, with a confirm, instead of two controls a thumb apart
Settings shows what is in a new Android build before you download it
Opening the app hands off from the splash instead of cutting to it
Back from Create account returns to the New here / Already a member choice, instead of dropping you on the login form
Sign in has a back control when you got there from that choice
The Android back button steps from the choice back to the intro pages
Pressing something now pushes it into the glass instead of just dimming it
Everything now moves on springs instead of fixed timings, so things settle rather than finish
Cards surface into place rather than sliding up the page
The mark under the navigation slides between tabs instead of blinking across
Settings > Appearance has a Motion switch: Spring is the new one, Classic is exactly how it was
The navigation bar has labels now, and an underline marks the tab you are on
The app icon is the gradient A, and both it and the splash mark are centred properly
After the four intro pages you pick a door: new here, or already a member
The update card no longer draws its buttons in the wrong place
The banner at the top no longer sits under the status bar
Settings now notices a new app build on its own, instead of waiting to be asked
The four intro pages are back, and they swipe
Cards and messages arrive one by one instead of the whole screen cross-fading
You can tell which tab you are on again, and the plus button no longer crowds the bar
LIVE only shows when something is actually playing or someone is listening
Sign in fits on one screen, so Create account is no longer below the fold
The app icon is fixed - it was being cropped away by Android before it ever drew
The plus button in the navigation is a whole circle again, not a clipped one
Sign in and Create account are separate now, and signing in no longer asks you to build a profile you already have
Password fields have a show/hide button
The session's bottom bar swipes up for change lobby and games, and light/dark now fades instead of snapping
A new look throughout: deeper background, glass navigation, and one colour reserved for what is live
Create a session from the button in the middle of the navigation bar
Mic, deafen and mute-one-person are on the session screen itself, not buried in a sheet
Direct messages have their own place in the navigation, with an unread count
Server moved to Mumbai — roughly six times faster than before
You will need to sign in again: this is a new database
Settings can now check for and install a new app build
Settings has a Software update section — apply an update you turned down earlier
A strip at the top of the app shows when you are on an older version
Update notes now cover every patch you skipped, not just the newest
The update sheet rises from the bottom and follows light and dark
Navigation fades everywhere; only a Session slides up
Returning to a screen animates properly instead of snapping
Direct messages: inbox, threads and composer
